claim: Two generations of WeChat chat-history exporters have ~55k combined stars and issue trackers full of people offering to pay — yet every one of them stops at 'export + a one-off yearly report'; nobody has built the archive you can keep asking questions of.
method: GitHub API age/stars/forks check on robbin/wechat-exporter (created 2026-07-28); issue-tracker sweep of WeFlow (13.5k stars, 229 forks, 71 open issues) and WeChatMsg (41.9k stars, 5,270 forks) for first-hand quotes; web search for user complaints about WeChat backup loss.
does: WeFlow and WeChatMsg decrypt a user's own local WeChat database and dump it to readable form; robbin/wechat-exporter (2026-07-28) compresses the whole chain — re-sign the client, pull the DB key from memory, decrypt to plaintext SQLite, register it as an MCP server — into a single Claude Code / Codex skill.
edge: The export step, which used to be a fragile multi-hour ritual, is now one command that ends with the corpus already wired into an agent you can talk to.
why_use: For a huge number of people WeChat is the single densest record of their life: a decade of family group chats, a parent's voice notes, a relationship from first message onward. It is local, encrypted, unsearchable across years, and routinely destroyed on device change.
gap: Existing exporters stop at one-off exports; no one has built a persistent, queryable archive of your own chat history.
counter: WeChatMsg has been at this since 2023 with 41.9k stars, so a well-funded incumbent could appear; decryption breaks whenever the desktop client updates (WeFlow's own users are currently stuck on an expired build), and the platform has no incentive to make this stable.
differentiator: Don't compete on exporting — start after the export, with one narrow job: pick a single family conversation, answer questions about it locally, and print it as a keepsake book. Cold start (Chinese): message the people in the WeFlow and WeChatMsg issue trackers and fork lists who are asking for a Mac build or an unexpired binary, then the comment sections of Xiaohongshu posts searched for 微信聊天记录 导出. Cold start (English): r/DataHoarder and r/China_irl, search 'WeChat export'.
value: One-time paid desktop app, plus printed keepsake books as the upsell — the same buyers who already pay shops to digitise family media.
risk: Decryption is version-fragile and sits in a grey zone with the platform's terms even though it is the user's own data; the product must be strictly local, own-data-only, with no cloud copy.

zh.claim: 两代微信聊天记录导出工具加起来约 5.5 万星，issue 区里有人直接说「有偿也行」——但它们全都停在「导出＋一次性年度报告」，没有一个把这堆语料变成能一直问下去的档案。
zh.does: WeFlow、WeChatMsg 把用户自己电脑上的微信数据库解密导出；robbin/wechat-exporter（2026-07-28 建仓）把「重签名取密钥→解密成明文 SQLite→注册成 MCP 直接问」整条链压成一个 Claude Code / Codex 技能，一条命令跑完。
zh.why_good: WeFlow、WeChatMsg 把用户自己电脑上的微信数据库解密导出；robbin/wechat-exporter 把整条链压成一条命令的技能，导完直接挂成能对话的数据源。
zh.why_use: 对很多人来说，微信是这辈子最密的一份记录：十年家庭群、爸妈的语音、一段关系从第一条消息开始。它就在本机，加密、跨年搜不动，而且换手机就常常整段消失。
zh.gap: 现有的要么是只有开发者跑得动的命令行/技能，要么是一次性的年度报告海报——没人做「导完之后能一直问」的那一层。
zh.counter: WeChatMsg 从 2023 年做到今天 41.9k 星，随时可能有人正规化补位；客户端一更新解密就失效（WeFlow 用户此刻就卡在过期版本上），平台也没有让它稳定的动机。
zh.differentiator: 不要在导出上竞争，从导出之后切进去，只做一件窄事：挑一段家人的对话，本地问答＋印成一本纪念册。冷启动（中文）：去 WeFlow / WeChatMsg 的 issue 区和 fork 名单，私信那些在喊求 Mac 版、求没过期的安装包的人，再去小红书搜「微信聊天记录 导出」的求助帖评论区。冷启动（英文）：r/DataHoarder 与 r/China_irl 搜 WeChat export。
zh.value: 一次性买断的桌面应用，纪念册打印作为增值——买家和已经花钱找店家数字化家庭影像的是同一批人。
zh.risk: 解密随客户端版本失效，且虽然是用户自己的数据，仍处在平台条款的灰色地带；产品必须严格本地、只处理本人数据、不留云端副本。
zh.hook: 把整段人生放在微信里的人：十年家庭群、爸妈的语音——而且已经因为换过一次手机丢掉过一部分。

hook: Anyone whose whole life is in WeChat — a decade of family group chats, a parent's voice notes — and who has already lost a chunk of it to one phone change.
consumer_angle: Turn your own chat history into a searchable, personal memory you can ask questions of — no technical skill needed.
pick_reason: Verified demand with paying users, clear gap in persistent archive, and a solo-friendly wedge via MCP integration.
